title: Return only eligible colleges when predicted_rank <= closing_rank

requirements.text: Update the backend prediction flow so that for each cutoff record, the system includes that record in the returned predictions only when predicted_rank is less than or equal to that record’s closing_rank (i.e., filter out non-eligible records instead of returning all evaluated records).

quotes:
For each cutoff record, check if predicted_rank is less than or equal to closing_rank.
If yes, include that college in the results.

acceptanceCriteria: Given imported cutoff data for a candidature, predictAdmission returns only predictions where predicted_rank <= closing_rank.
No predictions with predicted_rank > closing_rank are present in the predictAdmission response.
Eligible comparisons are performed per cutoff record (not globally), using that record’s closing_rank.

requirements.text: Adjust the predictions UI to reflect that the results list contains only eligible colleges (predicted_rank <= closing_rank) and ensure the table renders correctly with the filtered results returned by the backend.

quotes: If yes, include that college in the results.

acceptanceCriteria: After running predictions, the table only displays colleges that meet predicted_rank <= closing_rank (as returned by the backend).
Any user-facing text describing results is in English and does not imply that non-eligible records are shown.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo (no additional backend services).
Do not edit frontend files under frontend/src/components/ui or other immutable paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
Use English for any user-facing text.
nonGoals: Changing the rank computation formula (computeRank) or percentile validation rules.
Adding new authentication methods beyond Internet Identity.
Adding external databases or third-party services.
